split_batch_by_tags: split a data batch of images and metadata into groups by tag such as sup unsup_teacher and unsup_student
split_batch_supervised: split a batch of supervised images and metadata into separate groups using tags
split_batch_unsupervised: split a batch of unsupervised images into teacher and student groups by tag
review_split_batch: review the split_batch function that groups image tensors and metadata by tag labels
summarize_split_batch: summarize the split_batch utility that separates data batches into tagged groups for semi-supervised learning
